reply_text:
I haven't set up the Monday 08:00 digest yet. I posted two replies in #coastal-team's thread on your message, and the second corrects the first. The first wrongly said I had no scheduler. I do have a cron tool, but I haven't confirmed that a scheduled run can post into #coastal-team. The output may stay local.

Two options:
1. I create the Monday 08:00 job now and check whether it posts to #coastal-team. If it doesn't, I'll tell you.
2. I run the digest by hand each week when you ask.

Reply with 1 or 2. Either way, the digest will leave out money terms, which go only to Anselm, June, and the account owner.
